h1: Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak — a party hostel by Bang Niang Beach for solo travellers who want to meet people
intro: If you're coming to Khao Lak solo and don't fancy a quiet resort room to yourself — Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak is the social, party-leaning hostel from the well-known Slumber Party Hostels chain, built around turning strangers into friends within a night. It sits in Bang Niang, Khuekkhak, a short walk from the beach, with 6- and 8-bed mixed dorms plus private Double rooms. There's a pool, a Barception bar and nightly activities, and it's an adults-only stay. Dorm beds start from approx ฿350/night.

body.html: Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak is one branch of the Slumber Party Hostels chain — the party-hostel brand backpackers on the social trail know from Koh Tao, Koh Phangan, Ao Nang and Koh Phi Phi. This Khao Lak outpost sits in the Bang Niang area of Khuekkhak, Takua Pa, with around 38 rooms. The selling point isn't fancy rooms — it's an atmosphere designed to help solo travellers meet people from the moment they walk in.

Rooms come as 6-bed and 8-bed mixed dorms for budget backpackers, plus private Double rooms with a King bed and en-suite bathroom for those who want more privacy while staying in the same vibe. Dorms are air-conditioned, with free Wi-Fi in both rooms and common areas and a 24-hour front desk. As you'd expect from a party hostel, rooms are functional and comfortable rather than designer beachfront suites.

"Came on my own and never felt alone — pool in the morning, the bar in the evening chatting to people from everywhere, then out with a group I'd just met. Khao Lak in a more fun version than I expected."

The heart of the place is the common space. There's a pool to cool off in and host poolside activities, plus the bar the chain calls Barception (check-in counter doubling as the bar), which is the centre of everything. Most evenings there's something on to get people talking — drinking games, pool parties, or simply heading out together at night. This is exactly why the property is adults-only — it's built for socialising, not for families with kids.

The location works well for anyone who wants to be near the beach on a budget. The hostel is in Bang Niang, within walking distance of Bang Niang Beach and Khuk Khak Beach, Khao Lak's more laid-back beach zone, surrounded by restaurants, the Bang Niang market and bars. Renting a scooter to explore Khao Lak–Lam Ru National Park, or heading to Thap Lamu Pier for a Similan diving boat, is easy from here since it's all on the same stretch.

To be honest, going by real guest sentiment: this is a relatively new property, so public reviews are still fewer than for the chain's older siblings in Ao Nang or Phi Phi, and comparison data is thinner. And because it's a party hostel, the thing to accept is noise — on nights with activities or a pool party, sound carries until late. If you're a light sleeper or want a quiet rest, this isn't it. A dorm is also a dorm: people come and go all night, so plan around privacy and your valuables.

In short, Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak suits solo travellers, backpacking pairs and young groups who come to Khao Lak for fun and new friends rather than a quiet sea view from the room. Dorm beds start around ฿350/night in low season and climb in high season (Nov–Apr). If you're travelling with family, with kids, or want a proper beachfront resort to relax in, look at Khaolak Merlin Resort or La Flora Khao Lak in this list instead — but if the goal is a social atmosphere on a few-hundred-baht budget, this does that job.

A tip from reading the chain's reviews: if you want to sleep better, ask for a private Double or a dorm away from the bar and pool, because party nights run late. Pack earplugs and an eye mask as standard for party-hostel dorm life. And book ahead in high season — social-style stays in Khao Lak are limited and the good beds fill quickly.

faqTitle: FAQ — Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak Hostel, Phang Nga

faq.q: Where is Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak and how close is the beach?
faq.a: It's in Moo 5, Khuekkhak, Takua Pa, Phang Nga, in the Bang Niang area of Khao Lak. You can walk to Bang Niang Beach and the Bang Niang market; Khuk Khak Beach is about 5 minutes by car and Thap Lamu Pier (for Similan boats) about 20 minutes.

faq.q: How much does Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Dorm beds start from approx ฿350/night for an 8-bed mixed dorm. There's a less-crowded 6-bed dorm, plus a private Double room with a King bed and en-suite bathroom for those who'd rather skip dorms. Rates rise in high season (Nov–Apr), so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Who is Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for solo travellers, backpacking pairs and young groups who want a social atmosphere, a pool and bar, and to meet new people. It's an adults-only property, so it isn't suited to families with children or anyone wanting a quiet, restful stay.

faq.q: Does Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak have a pool and bar?
faq.a: Yes — there's a pool for cooling off and poolside activities, plus the Barception bar that's the chain's social hub. Most evenings there's something on to get people mingling. Wi-Fi is free in rooms and common areas, with a 24-hour front desk.

faq.q: Is Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak noisy — can you sleep well?
faq.a: It's a party hostel, so nights with activities or a pool party can be loud until late, especially near the bar and pool. To sleep better, ask for a private Double or a dorm away from the bar, and pack earplugs and an eye mask. Very light sleepers may prefer a quieter stay.

faq.q: Does Slumber Party Surf Khao Lak accept children?
faq.a: It's an adults-only property, built for a party and social atmosphere. Families with children should choose another Khao Lak stay, such as Khaolak Merlin Resort or La Flora Khao Lak, which are more family-friendly.
